name: auspost.com.au
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 21 images are more than twice the size shown.
lesson: Resize images to at most twice the width they are shown at, and give phones smaller files with srcset.
summary: auspost.com.au scores 72 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 30 are at risk, and 36 pass. Fix first: tracking starts on load and no banner asks first.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw LinkedIn Insight (5 requests), Meta Pixel (2 requests), Google Ads (1 request), Adobe Analytics (1 request), and cookies _gcl_au, demdex on demdex.net,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 21 images are more than twice the size shown
fix.evidence: photo-business-customer-van-collection-… on / (1280×960 shown at 379×213, 256 KB, about 189 KB to save), photo-literacy-mother-child-reading-boo… on / (1280×852 shown at 382×255, 197 KB, about 127 KB to save), community-grants-2400x1350.jpg on / (1280×719…
fix.fix: Resize images to at most twice the width they are shown at, and give phones smaller files with srcset and sizes.

fix.title: Scripts fingerprint the browser on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, auspost.com.au drew hidden text on a canvas and read it back, measured which fonts are installed, and rendered a silent audio tone; ct.captcha-delivery.com measured which fonts are installed. Read together, these…
fix.fix: Find the tag behind each host and hold it until consent, like a tracking cookie. If it is fraud or bot protection, name it in the privacy notice.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Adobe Analytics appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
The start page arrived in 126 ms
Every page has a meta description
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
